id: title:Gilbert09:replace a source ph debug column instead of duplicating it

review.reason: Adds a check for an existing `_ph_debug` column before appending a new one, and if present, replaces the column rather than appending a duplicate. This could prevent duplicate or conflicting debug metadata columns in warehouse tables imported by PostHog, preserving existing debug info while still attaching the current load ID.
review.uncertainty: Only P1.F1.H1 is supplied; no other hunks or surrounding context are available, so this cannot establish whether this is an isolated maintenance change or part of a broader warehouse ingestion improvement.
